title: Dessau Day Trip from Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Three Bauhaus sites within about 2 km of Dessau Hauptbahnhof:** the Bauhaus Building, the Masters' Houses on Ebertallee and the Bauhaus Museum Dessau.

**Until 20 November the RE7 is replaced by buses between Bad Belzig and Dessau.** Take the RE3 to Lutherstadt Wittenberg and the RB51 on: about **2 hours 10 minutes** from Berlin Hauptbahnhof, arriving at 49 past the hour.
**Coming back, the RB51 leaves Dessau at 10 past every second hour** (14:10, 16:10, 18:10, 20:10). From 21 November the RE7 runs again from Berlin-Charlottenburg in about 1 hour 30 minutes.
**Mondays are the trap.** March to October the museum is shut on Mondays; November to February all three sites close on Mondays and open **10:00 to 17:00**, Tuesday to Sunday.
**English public tours run only on Fridays from March to October**, none in winter. The all-in-one ticket is **29 euros** and covers all three sites for three days.
**My move:** go Tuesday to Friday, start at the Bauhaus Building at 10:00, finish at the museum, and book the museum's time-slot ticket before you travel.
